mappings.source_claim: The revealed product front/screen looks amazing.
mappings.feature: White dress with visible floral lace, V neckline, flared half sleeves, defined waist and tiered skirt construction.
mappings.benefit: Lets viewers inspect the dress's visible decorative design and silhouette details before a try-on.

proof.observed: Full hanging product view visibly shows the listed construction details.

mappings.cta: Ask viewers whether they want a full try-on demonstration.

mappings.source_claim: Tactile control clicks demonstrate product interaction.
mappings.feature: Visible lace texture, scalloped edges and layered seam/detail construction.
mappings.benefit: Provides a closer visual/tactile-style inspection of decorative workmanship without asserting unverified fabric quality.

proof.observed: Lace pattern and scalloped edges are visible; fabric composition and quality are not proven.

mappings.cta: Invite a follow-up try-on rather than making a purchase-performance promise.

mappings.source_claim: A fuller gameplay test can be shown later.
mappings.feature: A future full-body try-on can show how the dress appears when worn.
mappings.benefit: Gives viewers a clear next content step before deciding whether to learn more.

proof.observed: CTA requests viewer interest; it does not claim an outcome.

mappings.cta: If you want a full little try-on test, tell me.

removed_unsupported_claims: No claim about fabric composition, softness, comfort, stretch, fit, sizing, durability, slimming effect, occasion suitability, price, reviews, certification or brand authenticity is permitted from the supplied image alone.
